people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.
translations.bsb: Then Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jehoiakim and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
